summary: Help desk and live chat software with ticketing, call center and AI features.
access_note: 30-day free trial; admin creates a v3 API key under Configuration > System > API, sent in an apikey header. Interactive v3 docs are inside your own account.
blocker_note: Trial only; the v3 API reference is only visible inside a logged-in account; the MCP server is only on the Business and Enterprise plans.
notes: Could not read the v3 reference (behind login), so api_breadth and the apikey-header detail are inferences. Pricing page: MCP server is Business and Enterprise only. MCP support page: URL https://<your-liveagent-domain>/api/mcp, auth OAuth 2.1 (PKCE) or bearer token generated in the profile; the FAQ /public/api/mcp path conflict was not re-resolved.

evidence.quote: While logged in as an admin navigate to Configuration> System> API which loads the API v3 section where you find existing API keys or add a new one.
You can find whole LiveAgent API documentation within your LiveAgent account
